# Regex fixtures for skill: synthesize
# Format: one directive per non-empty, non-comment line.
#   MATCH: <prompt>     — regex from config/default-triggers.json for this skill must match
#   NO_MATCH: <prompt>  — regex must NOT match
# Tested deterministically by tests/test-regex-fixtures.sh (zero LLM cost).
# First NO_MATCH line is verbatim-borrowed from the panel MATCH fixture, and it is the
# trap this file exists for: "unmerged" is the standalone_panel contract's word for DO
# NOT merge, and an unanchored `merge` matched inside it -- routing the contract-opposite
# word to the contract-opposite skill. The combining verbs are word-anchored; this line
# fails if that anchoring is ever relaxed.
#
# synthesize had NO triggers until the contract-routing fix: its only route to
# selection was the bare English verb "synthesize", so it fired on "synthesize these
# notes" (a plain writing task) and missed "gather independent plans ... then merge
# them" (the synthesized_plan contract, stated without the word). The triggers below
# require the CONTRACT -- independent inputs, then a combining verb -- not the word.
# The NO_MATCH lines pin that boundary: an ordinary merge/combine/consolidate of
# things that are not independent model outputs must not route here.

MATCH: use independent plans and synthesize the final implementation plan
MATCH: gather independent plans from multiple models then merge them into one plan i can execute
MATCH: combine the independent answers into a single recommendation
MATCH: reconcile the independent assessments into one plan

NO_MATCH: get independent answers from several models and show them to me unmerged
NO_MATCH: run a panel of models on this design
# ACCEPTED, NOT A BUG: "merge the two independent plans into one backlog" DOES match.
# It is a genuine merge of independent plans, just human ones. synthesize invokes no
# model, so a spurious hint here costs nothing outbound; narrowing further would drop
# sy-1, which also names no model. Revisit only if synthesize ever gains an outbound path.
NO_MATCH: can you synthesize these notes into a summary
NO_MATCH: synthesize a changelog from the commit history
NO_MATCH: merge the feature branch into main
NO_MATCH: combine the separate outputs of the two scripts
NO_MATCH: reconcile the separate assessments into one plan
NO_MATCH: consolidate the duplicate css rules

# INFRASTRUCTURE-PROSE DECOYS (added after adversarial review found 11 false dispatches,
# 8 of them to skills that ship repo content to an external vendor). The first cut of
# these contract triggers was measured against an INVENTED negative corpus that had no
# MLOps/agent-infrastructure prose in it at all -- the one domain where "model", "agent",
# "response", "counter" and "exchange" are ordinary nouns. Every line below MATCHED a
# shipped trigger and routed outbound. Do not relax the clauses that keep them silent.
NO_MATCH: log the raw response from each model so we can diff them later
NO_MATCH: cache the raw response for each agent to avoid a second round trip
NO_MATCH: we need separate responses for each model in the serving layer
NO_MATCH: the sync counter drifts between them whenever the agent reconnects
NO_MATCH: make the agent challenge the certificate chain before connecting
NO_MATCH: ask the model to counter-sign the payload
NO_MATCH: the heartbeat exchange between the agents is dropping packets
NO_MATCH: document the message exchange between our agent and the broker
NO_MATCH: show each participant's response in an independent panel
NO_MATCH: render the api response in a standalone panel component
NO_MATCH: consolidate the separate assessments from qa and security into one report
NO_MATCH: combine the separate takes on the migration into a single doc

# PER-CLAUSE COVERAGE IS LOAD-BEARING (mutation-verified 2026-09-16).
# Every trigger clause for this skill is depended on by at least one MATCH line above:
# blanking any single clause in config/default-triggers.json produces >=1 failing
# assertion here. Verified by emptying each clause in turn in a scratch copy --
# design-debate 1-4, panel 2-3, synthesize 0 -- all 7 caught.
#
# CORRECTION to the commit message of 342221f, which claimed "fixtures alone would NOT
# have caught" a silently-empty extracted regex. That is FALSE as written. It was true
# only in the window before these MATCH lines existed. Keep it true: when you ADD a
# trigger clause, add a MATCH line that fails without it -- otherwise a neutered clause
# ships green.

# CROSS-DOMAIN DECOYS (second adversarial pass, Codex). The first narrowing still routed
# these outbound: delivery words like "verbatim" and "side by side" are ordinary
# formatting vocabulary in legal, finance, scientific, HR and education writing, and
# "agents" is robotics/simulation vocabulary. Every panel and design-debate trigger now
# requires an AI-participant token (model/llm/named vendor); these lines fail if that
# requirement is ever relaxed back to delivery words or bare reciprocals.
NO_MATCH: quote the witness answers verbatim in the deposition summary
NO_MATCH: show the analysts opinions side by side for the investment committee
NO_MATCH: plot the dose response side by side with the control
NO_MATCH: include the candidates answers verbatim in the hiring report
NO_MATCH: preserve the sip response verbatim in the packet trace
NO_MATCH: add a standalone panel for the questionnaire answers
NO_MATCH: create a standalone panel showing candidate responses
NO_MATCH: write a classroom exercise where pupils argue both sides of the motion
NO_MATCH: summarize how the attorneys rebut each other in this transcript
NO_MATCH: animate a back and forth between two agents in the evacuation simulation

# TWO VENDORS + independence + a combining verb. All three cues required, because any two
# of them describe ordinary engineering work.
MATCH: have codex and gemini each write their own test strategy without seeing the other's, then synthesize
MATCH: independent backfill plans out of gpt-5 and claude opus, then fold them together into one
